name: limit_engraved_text_entirely_outside_the_part
why: The anchor at 200 mm from a face 100 wide: the inscription touches the part nowhere. Without the check on the box this case would go all the way to the cut, and there `FeatureCut4` returns NULL -- measured. It would be a refusal, but the wrong one: «the feature was not created and SOLIDWORKS does not say why», instead of «the text is entirely outside the face, by 152 mm».
_why_failing_is_not_enough: A red that fires for the wrong reason proves nothing and looks identical to one that works. Here the message MUST say by how much it sticks out: it is the only piece of information with which whoever got the number wrong can correct it at the first try instead of by trial and error.
